LanguageData.Grechka_RescueDroneT1_Unit.label: rescue drone T1
LanguageData.Grechka_RescueDroneT1_Unit.description: A fireproof rescue drone. Carries injured allies to medical beds and extinguishes fires with area-effect foam. When enabled, captures downed enemies if prison beds are available. Drops a carried enemy to rescue an ally.

LanguageData.Grechka_WarriorDroneT1_Unit.label: warrior drone T1
LanguageData.Grechka_WarriorDroneT1_Unit.description: A fireproof melee combat drone with a large health pool. Patrols the home area and defends the colony from attackers. Retreats to its dock for repairs at 30% health.
